tools.name: inspect_domains
tools.description: Live 4-stage enrichment for 1–25 unique domains per call: detects ecommerce platforms & marketing/support/pixel stack (Shopify, WooCommerce, Klaviyo, Gorgias, Recharge, Meta/TikTok Pixel, GA4), samples public Shopify /products.json catalog counts & native-currency min/median/max prices, scores 1.0–5

tools.name: get_inspection_results
tools.description: Retrieve saved results for a previously submitted StoreTechScan job_id (from inspect_domains or web workspace) at 0 credit cost. Useful if a network connection dropped during an inspection.

tools.name: check_credits
tools.description: Check your StoreTechScan credit balance and recent ledger transactions (when authenticated via Authorization: Bearer or X-API-Key HTTP header), or view the anonymous 25-domain/UTC-day free preview policy and pay-as-you-go pack pricing. Costs 0 credits.

tools.name: buy_credits
tools.description: Create a one-time credit pack checkout for a human to pay in their browser. Show only checkout_url to the human; keep session_id and claim_token with the agent and never put claim_token in a browser URL. After payment, poll claim_purchase every 10–15 seconds for up to 15 minutes. The API key appears

tools.name: claim_purchase
tools.description: Poll a purchase created by buy_credits using the agent-held session_id and claim_token. While ready is false, wait retry_after_seconds before retrying (up to 15 minutes). Once the human has paid, returns the API key for the agent to store securely and use in the MCP connection or REST Authorization

tools.name: get_ecommerce_benchmark_2026
tools.description: Retrieve empirical benchmark findings across 235 deduplicated real storefronts comparing unpaced burst HTTP (29.4% reachability, 155 HTTP 429s) vs. paced inspection (92.8% reachability, 95.9% cohort consistency, 100% zero-drift native-currency price medians). Costs 0 credits.
